meta.title: Liang Gu
meta.description: Run sessions only during DeepSeek's idle hours: peak hours are Beijing time Monday to Friday 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 (Chinese statutory holidays excluded); everything else — lunch break, nights, weekends, and entire holidays — is idle time. During peak hours an enabled session's agent is held, prompts you send meanwhile stay queued, and work resumes automatically once idle time begins. Toggle it per session; peak windows, time zone, the holiday list and the default for new sessions are hot-reloadable on the settings page.
